text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing. While 
riding the train, Victoire Pisa became 
fast friends with the person next to her.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —Oh my. A footbath, you say?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman in the Next Seat
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the scenery is lovely, and they even 
rent out yukata. It's such a wonderful 
place~.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman in the Next Seat
text_block_list.text:
Legs are everything to an Umamusume, 
right? I'd really love for you to check it 
out~.

And so. Since we had some time, we went 
straight to the recommended footbath.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I can feel the tension melting 
away from my whole body.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it really hits home...
Yeah, it really hits the spot...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? That strap over there...

text_block_list.name: Lady Sitting Next to Me
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, this white thing? You get this if 
you come here often enough.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so? The older lady who 
recommended this to me was wearing the 
same thing, so I couldn't help but ask.

text_block_list.name: Lady Sitting Next to Me
text_block_list.text:
Wearing this... Ah, could it be an elegant 
elderly lady holding a red cane?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right. Are you an acquaintance 
of theirs, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Lady Sitting Next to Me
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We're foot bath friends who met right 
here.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My, my, is that so? What a wonderful 
coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
How long have you been here, Dear Sister? 
Do you have any recommendations on how to 
spend one's time?

text_block_list.name: Lady Sitting Next to Me
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm so glad I got to talk to 
Pisa-chan~. All my work stress is just 
melting away~~.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Really? Fufufu.
choice_data_list:
(They've become friends in the blink of an 
eye again!)

text_block_list.name: Lady Sitting Next to Me
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right. I recently found this 
really relaxing, hidden-gem spot...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: It's truly beautiful...

After leaving the footbath, we headed 
straight for the small aquarium that had 
been recommended to us.
choice_data_list:
(Pisa's ability to connect with others is 
amazing.)

(Pisa's ability to connect with others is 
amazing.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Taishin-san. Hello, what a 
coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Why are you here...? I thought this 
aquarium was a total hidden gem.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Through a bit of serendipity, I found my 
way here. An acquaintance told me it was 
their secret spot.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. ...Well, it shouldn't spread in any 
weird way then.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...This is truly a wonderful place. I can 
understand completely why you'd want to 
keep it a secret."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Now then, shall we be taking our leave?
choice_data_list: Are you good now?
Are you good now?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I've seen plenty already. ...Well 
then, Taishin-san, see you later.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —In a back alley.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If you take the back alley immediately to 
the left outside, it's a shortcut to the 
station. ...See ya.

By the time we left the aquarium, the sky 
was completely dyed in madder red.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Taishin-san's shortcut. It really felt 
like a secret path only for those in the 
know—it was so exciting!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Still... phew. It was a truly meaningful 
day...♪
choice_data_list:
You looked like you were having fun the 
whole time, after all.

You looked like you were having fun the 
whole time.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes. I've had so much fun the entire time.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"It feels as though I am walking across a 
bridge built from human connections..."
choice_data_list: Let's do it again some other time.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: I had fun too, so if Pisa's okay with it—

I had fun too, as long as you're okay with 
it, Pisa.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! By all means...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu. To think that you would make a 
suggestion like that, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm really looking forward to it 
already... ♪
choice_data_list: Even so, you're a great conversationalist.
Even so, you're a great conversationalist.
It's rare to see you in such high spirits.
It's rare to see you in such high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm really looking forward to it 
already... ♪
choice_data_list: Even so, you're a great conversationalist.
Even so, you're a great conversationalist.
It's rare to see you in such high spirits.
It's rare to see you in such high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ? Do you really think so?
choice_data_list:
Yeah. It's amazing how quickly you can 
make friends with anyone.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Come to think of it, I used to 
trouble my mother like that in the past.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
You make new friends so fast that you 
can't even remember their names, huh?
choice_data_list: Ah, that sure sounds tough.
Ah, that definitely sounds tough.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, Mother started carrying 
around a notepad. ...Fufu, she was quite a 
handful."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ! ...M-My apologies. It slipped out.
choice_data_list:
Come on, feel free to let loose and have 
more fun!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: M-More?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm really, reeeally looking forward to 
it...♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Um... would something like this do...?
